theme_strategy: Dark theme default (Focus Room Charcoal/Burgundy Editorial System), reflecting a premium, focused, deep aesthetic. No pure black, no pure white. Muted luxury.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, Editorial blocks, Persona headers. Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.

body.usage: Data tables, input fields, general UI, Project details.

monospace.usage: Visible retrieval trace, Context Router JSON, MCP tool calls.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Surface-based elevation using 1px borders and very subtle ambient glows (e.g., shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(110,13,37,0.15)] for active burgundy states). NO deep drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #292524. For active or selected states, use border-[#6E0D25].
visual_enhancers.textures: Use grain/noise overlays (opacity 2-5%) on the main background to eliminate digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for floating elements (Context Router overlays, Persona Pass modal). Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0c0a09]/80 with a 1px border-white/5. NO fully transparent overlays.

layouts_and_grids.global_spacing: Generous. p-6 to p-12 for containers. gap-6 to gap-12 for bento grids.
layouts_and_grids.app_shell: Collapsible left sidebar (charcoal base) + Main content area. Full viewport height.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grids: For Persona Core and Project Holders, use asymmetrical bento grids. Use col-span-full for the main summary, col-span-1 or 2 for specific context traits.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Left-align all content and dense data. Center alignment only for empty states.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle 2px radius. bg-[#6E0D25] text-white for primary. border border-[#292524] hover:bg-[#292524] text-[#fafaf9] for secondary.
components.cards: Flat background (#1c1917), 1px subtle border (#292524), no drop shadow. Hover: slight border color shift to burgundy.
components.inputs: Shadcn components, but stripped of rounded corners (radius-none). bg-[#0c0a09] border-[#292524] focus:border-[#6E0D25] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#6E0D25].
components.tables_and_lists: Row-based border-b border-[#292524]. No side borders.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and cards gently shift background color. No excessive scaling.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion: fade in and slide up (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1) over 0.4s.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Retrieval trace in the Playground should stream in with a typewriter effect or stagger fade-in.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure off-white text (#fafaf9) on charcoal (#0c0a09) meets 4.5:1 ratio. Burgundy accents used for UI structure, not primary text.
accessibility.focus_states: High contrast ring focus ring-[#6E0D25] on all interactive elements.

login_hero_texture.description: Dark charcoal texture for login page background or empty states.

persona_pass_accent.description: Deep burgundy watercolor texture for the Persona Pass/QR card background.

key_functionalities_guidelines.demo_owner_auth: Centered minimalist session unlock/login form over the charcoal texture. Editorial typography for the greeting.
key_functionalities_guidelines.persona_core: Two-pane view. Left: Base Persona (immutable core traits). Right: Living Persona (dynamic updates). Use bento grids to organize traits.
key_functionalities_guidelines.project_holders: Dashboard grid of active projects. Progress proposals in a distinct 'approval pending' state with a burgundy pulsing dot.
key_functionalities_guidelines.context_router: Node-like or dense tabular view showing how context is mapped to queries. Display immutable checkpoints clearly.
key_functionalities_guidelines.playground: Split view: Chat on the left, 'Visible Retrieval Trace' on the right in Monospace font. MCP server endpoints clearly visible as tags/badges.
key_functionalities_guidelines.persona_pass: Modal overlay featuring a QR Code on a burgundy textured card, with toggle switches for permissions and a revocation action.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the EXACT Charcoal/Burgundy Editorial System. No generic Tailwind blues or grays.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex bento grids; use customized Shadcn for forms, dialogs, dropdowns.
Ensure all fonts are loaded correctly (Cormorant Garamond, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Build the app connecting to the local Mongo-backend adapter and Gemini API.
Ensure the full demo works in the Preview tab (use visual representation or mock for MCP if ports cannot be exposed, but visually show the MCP trace).
Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: left; } ).
Make sure navigation handles Persona, Projects, and Playground.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
